translationRepairs: Xuzhou Kuangguo Army observation and retention commissioner, acting Scattered Command all-armies commander, honorary Grand Mentor Wang Yanzhang was made Kuangguo Army military commissioner, advanced to Marquis Who Opens the State, military posts unchanged.

Xu Prefecture Kuangguo Army observation and retention commissioner, acting Scattered Command all-armies commander, honorary Grand Mentor Wang Yanzhang was made Kuangguo Army military commissioner, advanced to Marquis Who Opens the State, military posts unchanged.

Focus 許州 is Xu Prefecture, distinct from 徐州 (Xuzhou); the prior literal wrongly collapses them. Bare "Xu" in the proposal is incomplete beside neighboring -zhou forms; "Xu Prefecture" restores the place without new error.
Your servant, unworthily entrusted, has obtained charge of compilation oversight; wishing to redeem a vegetarian’s debt, I rashly trouble the primal gaze."
Your servant, unworthily entrusted, has obtained charge of compilation oversight; wishing to repay the debt of drawing an unearned salary, I rashly trouble the imperial gaze."
Focus 將贖素食 uses 素食 for drawing pay without merit, not vegetarian austerity, and 元覽 is the emperor’s inspection; the proposal corrects both misreadings without inventing content.
In the fourth month of summer, Chenzhou military commissioner Prince of Hui You Neng rebelled and raised troops toward the palace.
In the fourth month of summer, Chenzhou prefect Prince of Hui You Neng rebelled and raised troops toward the palace.
Focus 陳州刺史 names a prefect (刺史), not a military commissioner (節度使); the replacement restores the office while leaving the rest of the sentence intact.

On jihai in the sixth month, General Inspector of all-circuit legal goods and honorary Minister of Works, acting Left Valiant Cavalry senior general Li Su was made Right Majestic Guard senior general.

On jihai in the sixth month, General Inspector of all-circuit legal goods and honorary Minister over the Masses, acting Left Valiant Cavalry senior general Li Su was made Right Majestic Guard senior general.
Focus 檢校司徒 is honorary Minister over the Masses; Minister of Works is 司空. The proposed title correction matches the Chinese office.
On jiachen Prince of Heng You Liang was enfeoffed Prince of Siguang.
On jiachen Prince of Heng Zhu Youliang was enfeoffed as succeeding Prince of Guang.
Focus 嗣廣王 is succession to the Prince of Guang title, not a placename "Siguang"; the proposed idiomatic restores that sense and names Zhu Youliang consistently with the Liang imperial house.
On jiachen, an edict made Specially advanced, honorary Grand Mentor, Prince of Heng You Liang able to be enfeoffed Prince of Siguang.
On jiachen, an edict enfeoffed Specially Advanced, honorary Grand Mentor, Prince of Heng Zhu Youliang as succeeding Prince of Guang.
Focus 制以…可封嗣廣王 enfeoffs him as succeeding Prince of Guang; "Prince of Siguang" and "able to be enfeoffed" both misread the Chinese, and the proposal repairs title and grammar.
Dai Siyuan again took Qimen, Gongcheng, Xinxiang, and three other counties.
Dai Siyuan also took the three counties of Qimen, Gongcheng, and Xinxiang.
Focus 淇門、共城、新鄉等三縣 means those three counties, not three additional unnamed ones; the proposal removes the invented extras.
West of Cao and south of Xiang fell to Liang; Jin lost a third of its stores.
West of Chan and south of Xiang fell to Liang; Jin lost a third of its stores.
Focus 澶州 is Chan Prefecture; 曹州 would be Cao. Replacing Cao with Chan corrects the place without other change.
From this west of Cao prefecture and south of Xiang prefecture all belonged to Liang; Jin men lost one-third of army stores.
From this point, everything west of Chan Prefecture and south of Xiang Prefecture belonged to Liang; Jin lost one-third of its military stores.
Focus 澶州之西 requires Chan Prefecture, not Cao; the proposed literal fixes that place-name error and remains faithful to 皆為梁有 and 失軍儲三分之一.
On dingwei in the seventh month the Tang army marched south along the river.
On dingwei in the seventh month the Tang emperor led his army south along the river.
Focus 唐帝引軍 along the river makes the Tang emperor the agent who led the army; collapsing the subject to "the Tang army" drops both 唐帝 and 引. The proposal restores person and verb.
Xuzhou had sent a green-haired tortoise; the palace built a "Tortoise Hall" to house it.
Xu Prefecture had sent a green-haired tortoise; the palace built a "Tortoise Hall" to house it.
Focus 許州 is Xu Prefecture, not 徐州/Xuzhou; "Xu Prefecture" correctly distinguishes the place that presented the tortoise.
Earlier, Xuzhou presented a green-haired tortoise; within the palace a chamber was built to keep it, named "Tortoise Hall."
Earlier, Xu Prefecture presented a green-haired tortoise; within the palace a chamber was built to keep it, named "Tortoise Hall."
Focus 許州 again names Xu Prefecture; replacing Xuzhou removes the wrong prefecture identity in the literal.

On jiachen Wen Zhaotu—Hedong circuit Western Campaign liaison commissioner, former Jingsheng Army military commissioner and Chongyu and other prefectures observation and disposition commissioner, specially advanced, honorary Grand Preceptor, and co-equal chief minister—was made Kuangguo Army military commissioner and Chen, Xu, and Cai observation and disposition commissioner.

On jiachen Wen Zhaotu—Hedong circuit Western Campaign liaison commissioner, former Jingsheng Army military commissioner and Chongyu and other prefectures observation and disposition commissioner, Specially Advanced, honorary Grand Commandant, and co-equal chief minister—was made Kuangguo Army military commissioner and Chen, Xu, and Cai observation and disposition commissioner.
Focus 檢校太尉 is honorary Grand Commandant; Grand Preceptor is 太師. The proposal corrects only that title mismatch.

Northern Campaign deputy Pacification commissioner, Kuangguo Army military commissioner, and Chen, Xu, and Cai observation commissioner Wang Yanzhang, Minister of Works and honorary Grand Mentor, was made deputy military commissioner of the Xuanyi Army, acting commissioner, and observation commissioner of Zheng, Hua, and Pu, retaining his former Northern deputy Pacification post.

Northern Campaign deputy Pacification commissioner, Kuangguo Army military commissioner, and Chen, Xu, and Cai observation commissioner Wang Yanzhang, Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and honorary Grand Mentor, was made deputy military commissioner of the Xuanyi Army, acting commissioner, and observation commissioner of Zheng, Hua, and Pu, retaining his former Northern deputy Pacification post.
Focus 光祿大夫 is the prestige title Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, not Minister of Works (司空); the replacement restores the correct office label.
